_comment: A seep TYPE: what kind of hole this is, what it looks like, and what can come through it. The trade reads the entry to know the pest -- ants fit a 1/25-inch crack -- so the hole declares its own fauna, with weights for the mix, min_wave for when a species joins the assault, and min_depth for how far down it starts riding this hole at all -- the law of depth applied to the bestiary rather than to the numbers. The assault (swarm.json) still owns pacing; this owns the WHO.
